context: Asuka and Mei admire a traditional craft.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: craft discussion; vocabulary (腕/床/模様/詳しい/香り) in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: この織物、模様が細かくて素敵ですね。
lines.en: This textile's pattern is fine and lovely.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle engaged delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 職人の腕が、よく表れていますね。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm reflective clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 床に飾ると、部屋が華やぎますね。
lines.en: Placed on the floor, it brightens the room.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 先生は、模様の意味に詳しいですね。
lines.en: You're knowledgeable about the patterns' meanings.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm reflective clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ほのかな香りも、しますね。
lines.en: It has a faint scent too.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 草木の香りが、染み込んでいますね。
lines.en: The scent of plants is steeped in it.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm reflective clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 見ていると、胸が温かくなります。
lines.en: Looking at it warms my heart.
lines.style: moved woman voice, soft warm tender delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 腕のいい職人が、おっしゃっていましたよ。
lines.en: A skilled artisan was saying so too.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm reflective closing clarity throughout
